name: Droylsden Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Droylsden Methodist Church. Open Tue and Fri 10am-2pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Tameside Council Allotments
short_description: Tameside Council allotment sites in Droylsden area
description: Council manages sites at Droylsden and Hurst Cross. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage.

name: Droylsden Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Richmond Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Local park with playground and sports facilities.
